type: MVEI kernel certificate for a branch

history_not_on_default_branch.subject: Improve documentation: clarify Lean4 skeleton is a specification
Add Riemann Hypothesis refutation framework: LaTeX, Lean4, and README

verification.checker: Lean 4 kernel; axioms read with Lean.collectAxioms (#print axioms)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Framework_Depends_On_Law4
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: : (∀ ρ : ℂ, ρ ∈ NonTrivialZeros → ρ.re ∈ GlobalMinima T) → (GlobalMinima T ≠ {1/2}) → ¬RiemannHypothesis

theorems_only_on_branches.name: LocalPotential_nonneg
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (σ t : ℝ) : 0 ≤ LocalPotential T σ t

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MostPlausibleRefutation
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (h_strict : ∃ σ₀ : ℝ, 0 < σ₀ ∧ σ₀ < 1 ∧ σ₀ ≠ 1/2 ∧ EnergyFunctional T σ₀ < EnergyFunctional T (1/2)) (h_link : ∀ ρ : ℂ, ρ ∈ NonTrivialZeros → EnergyFunctional T ρ.re = MinEnergy T) : ¬RiemannHypothesis

theorems_only_on_branches.name: RF1_MinimumOffCriticalLine
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (h_regularity : ∀ σ, 0 < σ → σ < 1 → EnergyFunctional T σ = EnergyFunctional T (1 - σ)) (h_displaced : ∃ σ₀ : ℝ, 0 < σ₀ ∧ σ₀ < 1 ∧ σ₀ ≠ 1/2 ∧ EnergyFunctional T σ₀ ≤ EnergyFunctional T (1/2)) (h_link : ∀ ρ : ℂ, ρ ∈ NonTrivialZeros → ρ.re ∈ GlobalMinima T) : ¬RiemannHypothesis

theorems_only_on_branches.name: RF2_NonPositiveCurvature
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (h_morse : ∀ σ t, 0 < σ → σ < 1 → (deriv (fun σ' => LocalPotential T σ' t) σ = 0 → deriv (deriv (fun σ' => LocalPotential T σ' t)) σ ≠ 0)) (h_curvature : deriv (deriv (EnergyFunctional T)) (1/2) ≤ 0) (h_zeros_stable : ∀ ρ : ℂ, ρ ∈ NonTrivialZeros → deriv (deriv (EnergyFunctional T)) ρ.re > 0) : ¬RiemannHypothesis

theorems_only_on_branches.name: RF3_MultipleMinimalGeodesics
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (P : ℝ) (hP : P > 0) (h_multiple : ∃ γ₁ : ℝ → ℝ × ℝ, (∀ t, (γ₁ t).1 ≠ 1/2) ∧ GeodesicEnergy T γ₁ P ≤ GeodesicEnergy T CriticalGeodesic P) (h_zeros_on_minimal : ∀ ρ : ℂ, ρ ∈ NonTrivialZeros → ∃ γ, GeodesicEnergy T γ P = sInf { GeodesicEnergy T γ' P | γ' : ℝ → ℝ × ℝ } ∧ ρ.re = (γ 0).1) : ¬RiemannHypothesis

theorems_only_on_branches.name: weight_symmetric
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: : ∀ t : ℝ, weight T t = weight T (-t)
